verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents metadata filtering: vector search "combined with any filters", exact kNN over a filtered subset, regex search, filterable attributes, and permission filtering on `group_ids`, which hints at array membership. However, the evidence never shows the specific operators the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented range operators, geo filtering, nested boolean (And/Or/Not) composition, explicit array-membership operators, and hands-on corroboration of filter expressiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries

citations.quote: Vector search, >90% recall, combined with any filters
find the exact nearest neighbors over a filtered subset
Regex search, with fast trigram regex indexes
Store the `user_id` or `group_ids` that have read access directly on each document. At query time... pass them as a filter.
